newsitem.title: USA: Aon closes Alexander & Alexander tender.
newsitem.headline: Aon closes Alexander & Alexander tender.

text.p: Aon Corp said Wednesday that about 44 million shares or about 99 percent of the outstanding shares of Alexander & Alexander Services Inc were received under a $17.50 a share tender offer which expired January 14.

The tendered shares were purchased by an Aon subsidiary. The subsidiary is expected to be merged into Alexander & Alexander, with each share of Alexander & Alexander not tendered being converted into the right to receive $17.50 in cash following completion of the merger.
Also, as previously reported, on January 17, 1997, Aon will be acquiring Alexander & Alexander's series B preferred shares held by subsidiaries of American International Group Inc.
Aon is an insurance services holding company that includes insurance brokerage, consulting and consumer insurance companies.
Alexander & Alexander is a holding company which provides risk management consulting, insurance brokerage and human resource management consulting services worldwide.
Shares of Aon closed at 63-1/2 while shares of Alexander & Alexander closed at 17-3/8.
